Markets.title: Cube Highways Trust secures Rs.1,150 crore through AAA-rated NCDs
Markets.summary: Cube Highways Trust has raised Rs. 1,150 crore through a five-year issuance of senior secured NCDs with a 7.50% annual coupon rate. Axis Bank and ICICI Bank invested in the transaction, and the funds will be used for debt refinancing and capital projects.

Markets.title: Sebi to soon issue framework on Closing Auction Session; receives over 3,500 comments
Markets.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India will soon release a new framework for the Closing Auction Session mechanism after reviewing over 3,500 public comments. The regulator also plans to address derivatives settlement prices and corporate bond derivatives following these consultations.

Markets.title: Bitcoin holds near $84,000, Ethereum moves towards $2,700 as buyers remain active
Markets.summary: Bitcoin held near $84,000 and Ethereum moved toward $2,700 despite minor declines of 1.6% and 1.5% over the past 24 hours. Most major altcoins experienced corrections of up to 3.1%, while Tron gained 0.3%.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: 22,600 is a key Nifty support; Sudeep Shah discusses PB Fintech, Infosys, TCS strategy ahead of Q2
Markets.summary: Analyst Sudeep Shah of SBI Securities identifies 22,600 as a key support level for the Nifty index. He also discusses trading strategies for PB Fintech, Infosys, and TCS ahead of their Q2 earnings.

Markets.title: 9 large-cap stocks that surged over 50% in the first half of FY27
Markets.summary: Nine large-cap stocks have surged by more than 50% during the first half of FY27. These specific equities significantly outperformed the broader market benchmark, according to data from ACE Equity.

Markets.title: Stocks to buy: Axis picks 7 largecap stocks with upside potential of up to 44%. See full list
Markets.summary: Axis has selected seven large-cap stocks that offer robust value following recent market corrections. These stocks feature an estimated upside potential of up to 44 percent.

Geo-Political.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
Geo-Political.summary: A flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain with an axe, causing the plane to plunge more than 17,000 feet mid-flight. Passengers and crew successfully overpowered the attacker and subdued him.

Geo-Political.title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: Russia struck the Northern Bridge in Kyiv, according to the city's mayor. This attack follows recent repeated strikes on another major bridge in the capital.

Geo-Political.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
Geo-Political.summary: The G7 plans to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel to prevent further price spikes. This coordinated action is also intended to avoid a potential ban on United States diesel exports following threats from Donald Trump.

Geo-Political.title: US murderer Christa Pike unconscious and on ventilator after failed execution, lawyers say
Geo-Political.summary: Convicted US murderer Christa Pike is currently critically ill and unconscious on a ventilator in a Nashville hospital. Her lawyers report that this condition resulted from a failed execution attempt.

Geo-Political.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
Geo-Political.summary: Violent protests regarding educational standards and teacher shortages have disrupted approximately 735 schools across France. Riot police clashed with students as the unrest escalated.

Geo-Political.title: Women given shorts at Oktoberfest to prevent upskirting
Geo-Political.summary: Munich Oktoberfest organizers are providing female staff with shorts to prevent voyeuristic upskirting videos. This measure was introduced after thousands of such videos from the festival surfaced on social media.

Data & Insights.title: White-collar hiring shifts towards specialised AI skills, experienced professionals in September: Report
Data & Insights.summary: White-collar hiring in September shifted toward experienced professionals and candidates with specialised AI skills. The job market became more selective, impacting hiring opportunities for freshers and mid-career seekers.

Data & Insights.title: G7 unlocks 100 million barrels: Who holds world’s emergency oil and who decides when to release it? A deep dive
Data & Insights.summary: The G7 is releasing 100 million barrels of oil to combat tightening global energy supplies. The story examines which countries control these emergency reserves and the decision-making process behind their release.

Data & Insights.title: Forex reserves plunge record $18.3 billion as RBI steps in to support rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves fell by a record $18.34 billion to $747.56 billion during the week ending September 25. The sharp decline occurred as the Reserve Bank of India intervened in the market to support the rupee.

Data & Insights.title: Diesel Diplomacy! Trump says Europe will release ‘massive amount’ of diesel as China cuts fuel exports
Data & Insights.summary: Europe plans to release massive diesel reserves into the global market. This action comes as China restricts its own fuel exports, intensifying existing supply disruptions.

Data & Insights.title: India to face tougher competition for gas this winter? Here's what expert said
Data & Insights.summary: India may face higher liquefied natural gas costs this winter due to supply disruptions in Qatar. This shortage will tighten global markets and increase competition with Europe for alternative fuel supplies.

Data & Insights.title: Hormuz crude flows return to pre-war levels, yet oil may still stay at $90–$100 | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: Crude oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to pre-war levels with a seven-day average of 13.5 million barrels per day. However, oil prices may still remain between $90 and $100 because refined-fuel supplies remain low.

India.title: Biryani Barbs Fly As Assam By-Poll Campaign Heats Up
India.summary: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma and Congress MP Rakibul Hussain are engaged in a political feud involving food items like biryani, pulao, chicken, and dry fish. This verbal clash is taking place as the election campaign for the state by-polls heats up.

India.title: IIT Kharagpur Alumnus Pawan Chandana Among TIME's 100 Most Influential Rising Stars
India.summary: IIT Kharagpur alumnus and former ISRO scientist Pawan Chandana has been named in TIME's list of the 100 most influential rising stars. He achieved this recognition as the co-founder of Skyroot Aerospace.

India.title: How Aradhana Misra Won Ajay Rai-Rajendra Pal Clash And Rose In UP Congress
India.summary: Aradhana Misra secured a prominent post in the Uttar Pradesh Congress following widespread speculation within party circles. Her appointment came amidst a power clash between Ajay Rai and Rajendra Pal.

India.title: Odisha Government Revises Junior Teachers' Regularisation Order, Check Details
India.summary: The Odisha government has updated the rules for making schematic junior teachers in state-run primary and upper primary schools permanent. This revision changes the specific conditions and process for the regularisation of these educators.

India.title: Karnataka SSLC Exam Fees Hiked By 5% For Academic Year 2026-27: KSEAB Issues Circular
India.summary: The Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board has increased SSLC exam fees by 5% for the 2026-27 academic year. Fresh candidates will now pay Rs 746, while private registration fees have been set at Rs 260.

India.title: Pilgrims Caught In Hours-Long Traffic Jams On Way To Badrinath Dham
India.summary: Pilgrims travelling to Badrinath Dham are facing hours-long traffic jams due to steadily increasing vehicle pressure. Police and administrative teams are currently working at several locations to regulate traffic movement.

General.title: Widdecombe suspect charged with planning terror act against Farage
General.summary: Counter-terrorism police have charged a suspect with planning a terrorist act against politician Nigel Farage following an intensive investigation. The additional charge was announced by authorities investigating the incident involving the prominent British figure.

General.title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
General.summary: A flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain with an axe, causing the plane to plunge over 17,000 feet. Passengers and crew successfully overpowered the attacker two and a half hours into the flight.

General.title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says
General.summary: The mayor of Kyiv reports that Russian forces have struck the Northern Bridge, which is the second major bridge in the city to be attacked. This strike follows recent repeated attacks on another major bridge in the area.

General.title: Woman deceived ex-partner that she had given birth to his babies, judge rules
General.summary: The man paid his ex-partner around £30,000 over two years believing she had given birth to his children.

General.title: Suppliers pile pressure on government over energy bills
General.summary: The trade body Energy UK urges the government to take immediate action to help households struggling with energy bills this winter. Suppliers are increasing pressure on authorities as consumers face mounting financial difficulties.
